conflicts.annotation: Both values represent a target for the same indicator (% of hardship grant households with verified attendance follow-up within 45 days) but use different scales and different time horizons (proposal = full-programme target of 85%; AR1 logframe = Year-1 milestone of 0.75). The unit/scale inconsistency should be resolved by the programme team: confirm whether the logframe should express this indicator as a percentage (e.g. 75%) or a proportion (e.g. 0.85), and align across all documents.
